title: Coefficient four with error constants 51/4 and 25/2, diagonal shared-partner elimination, and trajectory subspace extraction

claims.statement: Joint CircuitBreaker theorem under rules.md: the following declaration defines ONE fixed eligible total uniform NP family in the pinned full B2 model at actual input length n. Its full guarantee and its declared projection both hold unconditionally, for all sufficiently large integer lengths with the quantifiers specified by the theorem kinds. Both score source claims assert this ENTIRE declaration, not separate lemmas. For g(n)=c*n^p*(log2 n)^q*(log2 log2 n)^r with the exact parameters in guarantee, liminf over all integer n of C_B2(f_n)/g(n) >= 1. Equivalently, for every epsilon>0 there is N_epsilon such that C_B2(f_n)>=(1-epsilon)*g(n) for every integer n>=N_epsilon. Otherwise let b be the least positive integer with 25^5*b^5>=24^5*N^3, and let ell be the first prime strictly larger than b found by deterministic trial division. Put m=N-ell, r=ceil(m/ell), and t=ceil(sqrt(r)). Read the first ell bits as the coefficients below the leading term of a monic degree-ell binary polynomial P. Output zero unless X^(2^ell)=X modulo P and gcd(P,X^2-X)=1. For a valid prefix, append r*ell-m zero bits to the remaining m payload bits and interpret the r consecutive ell-bit blocks as x_1,...,x_r in F_2[X]/(P), in the polynomial basis with constant coefficient first. Set w_i=r+2-i, y_i=x_i^(2^(w_i)-1), and output the absolute trace Tr_(K/F_2) of the order-t elementary symmetric polynomial in y_1,...,y_r. Every prefix bit counts in N; P is part of the input, not advice. claims: For the same family F_N defined in bound.json and proof.md, limsup over all integer N tending to infinity of max{0, 4*N - C_B2(F_N)} / N^(4/5) is at most 43849/3600. This is an unscored deficit bound proved in proof.md Part IV Section 3.

Unscored Theorem A (proof.md Part V Section 1). Let d>=0 be an integer, and let a full-cube fair representation on n free parameters (with a square invertible auxiliary matrix, rows of at most 3 nonconstant terms, an acyclic full-B2 gate list, and total size S = rows + gates) compute a function f on F_2^n that is nonconstant on every affine subspace of dimension > d. Suppose the representation contains t minimal AND-type gates G_j = (U_j+alpha_j)(W_j+beta_j)+gamma_j (1<=j<=t) such that for each j, U_j and W_j are distinct auxiliary variables of degree 2 appearing only in G_j and in 3-term equations E_(j,1): U_j+s_j+b_(j,1)=c_(j,1) and E_(j,2): W_j+s_j+b_(j,2)=c_(j,2) respectively, where {s_j, b_(j,1), b_(j,2)}_(j=1)^t are 3t distinct free parameters and each s_j has degree 2 (appearing only in E_(j,1) and E_(j,2)). If n-2t>=d+2, then S>=4n+3t-8(d+1), and if in addition G_1,...,G_t have at least t distinct gate children outside {G_1,...,G_t}, then S>=4n+4t-8(d+1).

Unscored Theorem B (proof.md Part V Section 2). Let C be an acyclic XOR/AND circuit on n input bits x in F_2^n with AND-gate set A = G_1 union G_2, where G_1 consists of all level-1 AND gates (whose two input pins have no AND-gate ancestors, so both input pins compute affine forms u_g, v_g in x) and G_2 = A \ G_1. Let G_(2,top) subset G_2 be any subset of G_2 with no directed path to any other AND gate in A. Let X_1 subset {x_1,...,x_n} be the set of input variables appearing with nonzero linear coefficient in at least one input form of a gate in G_1, and let S_1 subset X_1 be any subset such that no gate in G_1 has both of its affine input forms mentioning a variable in S_1. Then on an affine subspace V_m subset F_2^n of dimension at least |S_1| + (n - |X_1|) - |G_2 \ G_(2,top)|, every gate in G_1 union (G_2 \ G_(2,top)) restricts to an affine function, and if r_top <= 2*|G_(2,top)| denotes the dimension of the span of the homogeneous linear parts (on V_m) of the input forms of G_(2,top), then C is constant on an affine subspace V subset V_m of dimension at least |S_1| + (n - |X_1|) - |G_2 \ G_(2,top)| - min(|G_(2,top)|, floor(r_top / 2)) - 1.
